Most AI chat products stop at conversation—you ask a question, get a block of text, and that's it. But enterprise scenarios don't need chat; they need outputs: an architecture diagram, a deployed web page, a bill analysis report, executable code. That is exactly the starting point for building this AI Agent platform.
